rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 330 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (geopolitics led 11-24, policy_regulation led 11-25, so elections_public_opinion leads today, then geopolitics, then policy_regulation); within each group the list starts at offset 330 % group_size in pool order (elections 330 % 9 = 6: platform AI labeling first; geopolitics 330 % 10 = 0: chip export controls first; policy 330 % 15 = 0: EU AI Act first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds and agency press pages (korea.kr, pipc.go.kr, msit.go.kr, assembly.go.kr, digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu, gov.uk, ico.org.uk, cec.gov.tw, moda.gov.tw, mjib.gov.tw, whitehouse.gov, federalregister.gov) over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-25, so items published 11-25 (after the prior harvest) through 11-26 are in scope. Context: Thursday 11-26 in Korea and EU; US Thanksgiving Day — federal agencies, courts and state offices are closed, so US yield will be thin; the one US window is Wednesday 11-25 afternoon/evening ET releases (pre-holiday dumps: Federal Register public inspection for 11-27, White House, state AGs, court dockets) that post-date the prior harvest. Lean harder on Korea, EU/UK, Taiwan, Japan, China, Canada, India today. Korea: 국회 정기회 막바지 — 과방위·법사위 법안소위, 본회의 일정, 예결위 예산안(법정 처리기한 12-2); 목요일 국무회의 없음, 각 부처 보도자료(과기정통부·개인정보위·방미통위·선관위·문체부·산업부) 확인. EU: Parliament committees and Council working parties on the digital omnibus / AI Act delay; Commission AI Office guidance; EDPB plenary outputs. UK: DSIT/AISI/ICO/Ofcom releases. Taiwan local elections are Saturday 11-28: in the last 48 hours, NEW CEC/MJIB/MODA/NSB official counts, indictments, takedown orders or platform reports on AI deepfakes are high-value; previously covered counts/cases (Puma Shen indictment 11-22, ~2,700 Threads accounts 11-21, CIB 219 cases 11-13) do not qualify. Hooks — only official documents/actions are new, skip previews and reactions: Character.AI bankruptcy auction (42 AGs objection covered 11-25; a court ruling on the sale/auction terms or the Dec 1 auction outcome is new); Nvidia California AG subpoena (Huang testimony Dec 1 — skip previews); Grok/SpaceX state suits; NY AI chatbot toy ban (covered 11-25); PIPC AI-development privacy decree (covered 11-25 — only comment-period changes or the final 공포 are new). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
